release_identity.cache_identity: BuildName/CacheBust/ConfigStamp/UIStamp are derived from metadata.lua; v2.0.8 therefore uses a fresh release cache namespace

runtime_architecture.movement_ownership: RE4MovementCoordinator + RE4TravelResolver + one RE4TweenRuntime + follower that may write player position only while both resolver and tween are active
runtime_architecture.combat_ownership: RE4CombatTargetLock + RE4CombatPulse + one scheduler-managed RunService.Stepped FastAttack connection
runtime_architecture.bring_ownership: owner-scoped RE4BringService; core block unchanged from 2.0.7
runtime_architecture.character_lifecycle: RE4CharacterLifecycle/FeatureRuntime release movement, target, bring, combat, callbacks and task generations on stop/respawn

core_recovery.reference: Cr4Hub_base(1).lua was used selectively for Bypass TP, Berry, mastery flow and Farm All Island data; Cr4 polling/duplicate movement/combat loops were not copied
movement: Auto Farm Level accumulated jitter root cause: movement support could keep the follower alive after arrival; the follower could continue writing root CFrame from a stale block while a feature flag remained enabled
follower now writes player CFrame only while both TravelResolver and TweenRuntime are genuinely active; support/noclip state is separate from position ownership
combat target CFrame uses stable world-position offsets instead of inheriting mob root pitch/roll
same-owner destination updates now refresh Context/Priority/ArrivalRadius as well as CFrame so quest/spawn/combat phase changes cannot retain stale movement policy
dynamic combat/mastery targets disable the configured 450 near boost and stay on the stable 200 movement profile
long-route mild server correction rebases the single movement block to actual root and reissues only the current segment; map-scale external relocation remains handled by the transition replan path
2.0.7 SkyLower/SkyUpper transition awareness and bounded hazard replan remain intact
bypass_tp: toggle is strict opt-in and is initialized OFF on hub session/re-execute so UI and runtime state cannot diverge
eligible only for long ordinary-World movement; special regions, transition-sensitive Sky zones, seated state and critical-item travel are excluded
candidate spawn must be meaningfully closer to the destination and sufficiently separated from the current spawn
transport arbiter is one path: Bypass TP -> Portal Fast Travel -> Tween
once bypass mutates spawn state, an unconfirmed result is fail-closed for that resolver pass so a portal cannot immediately perform a second teleport
verification is bounded; there is no random delay, portal spam or infinite retry loop
berry: one farm.berry FeatureRuntime owner for collect/hop modes
BerryBush CollectionService tag is indexed once and maintained by tag/child signals rather than rescanning all bushes every scheduler pass
nearest valid cached berry is selected; disappeared berries invalidate immediately
prompt cooldown and stable-empty window avoid repeated prompt/server-hop churn
movement uses the shared coordinator; Berry contains no direct _tp call
abilities: Buso/Geppo/Soru/Ken ownership no longer falls back to generic live-object/backpack cache
ownership proof is restricted to explicit live signals, exact player data/attributes and GetUnlockables snapshot keys
unresolved ability state is rendered fail-closed as Not Owner instead of reporting Owner from object presence
Sea 1 purchase flow forces a fresh ownership snapshot/control refresh after purchase
mastery: existing Re4 exclusive MasteryController, action locks, target resolver, weaken threshold, cooldown gates and GunFireService remain the lifecycle owner
Fruit/Gun finish rotations now query one RE4MasteryCapabilities source shared by UI and runtime
Gun conservative fallback is Z/X only; C/V are exposed only when live skill UI or inventory metadata proves support
Fruit supports Z/X/C/V/F only when capability evidence or conservative fruit fallback allows them; runtime rejects unsupported selections
skill UI reacts to tool and skill UI add/remove events; ON/OFF/mode switch/respawn retain existing owner cleanup
farm_island: Cr4 Farm All Island mob/position data was curated into RE4Constants.FarmIslands
one farm.island FeatureRuntime worker reuses RE4EnemyIndex, Attack.Kill, MovementCoordinator and existing target/Bring/combat ownership
no per-island coroutine, nested workspace scan or direct _tp loop was ported
toggle starts from OFF on re-execute to avoid stale worker/UI state
preserved: RE4BringService implementation block is byte-identical to 2.0.7
raw InvokeServer/FireServer/RegisterAttack/RegisterHit call counts did not increase
ui.lua and all language files are byte-identical to 2.0.7; UI behavior changes come from shared metadata/state providers in main.lua

offline_regression.lua_validation: string/comment-aware delimiter and Luau block-balance lexical checks passed for main.lua/config.lua/constants.lua/ui.lua/metadata.lua; no Luau VM/compiler is installed in this container
offline_regression.json_validation: hub_info.json, runtime_manifest.json (pre-regeneration) and all language JSON files parse successfully

regression_matrix.auto_farm_level_long_run: static ownership path verified: feature flag may keep noclip support active, but follower has no player-position write authority after resolver/tween arrival; active same-owner requests refresh movement context when phase/target changes
regression_matrix.auto_farm_level_repeated_on_off: FeatureRuntime generation stop/restart remains authoritative; movement owner/target/bring/combat cleanup is invoked by token cleanup and coordinator release
regression_matrix.target_change_and_target_death: target lock validity/repair and movement TargetRevision paths remain; dynamic request context follows the current combat phase and target
regression_matrix.long_tween_server_correction: bounded correction signal cancels only the active tween segment, rebases block to actual root and reissues from current position; map-scale relocation uses the separate external transition handler
regression_matrix.bypass_off: RE4BypassTravel:IsEnabled requires _G.Bypass==true; session initializes it false
regression_matrix.bypass_on_with_portal: normal transport resolver evaluates Bypass first; verified success returns immediately; mutated-unconfirmed state blocks portal; non-eligible/no-mutation falls through to Portal then Tween
regression_matrix.berry_on_off_and_target_disappear: single FeatureRuntime owner; target cache invalidates on ChildRemoved/tag removal; OFF releases movement owner through FeatureRuntime and clears current berry target
regression_matrix.mastery_gun_fruit: exclusive MasteryController/action locks preserved; target, threshold, aim, normal gun fire, skill cooldown and capability gates share current owner state
regression_matrix.mastery_skill_ui: Gun fallback shows Z/X; live/inventory capability may reveal C/V; UI and runtime call the same capability resolver
regression_matrix.ability_purchase_refresh: purchase invalidates inventory/ownership caches and defers UpdateControls(true); periodic safety refresh remains available for external changes
regression_matrix.farm_island: single FeatureRuntime worker; shared enemy index + combat/movement pipeline; no nested per-island loop
regression_matrix.respawn: existing character lifecycle releases travel/target/bring/combat state; mastery capability UI character listeners disconnect/rebind
regression_matrix.sky_transition: 2.0.7 zone/transition guard is preserved; Bypass explicitly refuses transition-sensitive movement zones

offline_regression.live_verification: Roblox runtime is unavailable in this container. Server-authoritative correction magnitude, Bypass spawn/respawn behavior, current ability snapshot schema and concrete weapon skill UI must still be smoke-tested in game; the release therefore uses fail-closed/bounded paths where runtime proof is unavailable.

movement_update_2_0_6.scope: player movement/tween only; BringMob, mob movement, combat, attack and UI are unchanged

dynamic.implementation: two sequential tween phases; speed is never mutated on a running Tween
dynamic.guard_effect: cancel current near tween through the single runtime, suppress near boost for the rest of the session, and reissue the current route once at fallback speed

movement_update_2_0_6.live_validation_note: 350 cannot be certified from this offline container. It is treated as a short-range candidate and automatically disabled if observable movement instability occurs. 200 remains the only assumed stable baseline.

movement_update_2_0_7.scope: player movement/FastTravel topology only; BringMob, mob movement, combat, Fast Attack and UI are unchanged
root_cause: 2.0.6 classified all normal Sky layers as World, so route ownership had no layer identity after a map-triggered teleport
the -4607/874/-1667 entrance was stored as generic Sky2 even though the reference flow identifies the endpoint as Sky3Exit
the follower resynced block after a large root jump but did not invalidate the tween that was still interpolating toward the stale pre-transition route
solution: event-driven external relocation cancellation and bounded route re-resolution
session-local hazard learning and geometric detour for a repeated wrong-layer segment
movement_update_2_0_7.runtime_note: Exact trigger geometry is learned only when the game actually relocates the player; no single cloud coordinate is hardcoded into movement logic.

not_ported_as_separate_systems: Cr4 direct _tp Farm All Island loop
Cr4 sequential Bypass then requestEntrance behavior
release_update_2_0_8.missing_feature_audit_note: Farm All Island was the clearest reusable Cr4 farm gap and was added. Features that overlap existing Re4 Raid/Boss/Quest engines were not duplicated in this release.

dynamic_tween_profile.implementation: two sequential tween phases through the single RE4TweenRuntime; speed is never mutated on an active Tween
dynamic_tween_profile.guard: near-phase backtrack/stall/root-block divergence suppresses the near boost for the session and falls back to 200
